summary: Completed backend API regression and mobile end-to-end testing for seeded tools, filtering, rental modal, rental creation, history, role switching, and responsive navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: The implementation is concentrated in App.js and App.css but remains within the review threshold; no blocking correctness issue found.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST-prefixed rental requests through the public rental flow while validating persistence; no production tool records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core browse, search, category/availability filters, hourly pricing, duration stepper, rental POST/history, mobile navigation, and role switcher are covered. The first UI attempt used an incorrect expectation of two tractor matches and was corrected to the actual single match; no app defect resulted.
rca of the issue: No application issue reproduced. A test-only navigation timeout occurred because the mobile sidebar is intentionally hidden until the menu button is clicked; opening the sidebar before selecting role controls passes.
